verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a first-party browser-actions feature that can click, wait, or scroll before Scrape captures a page, and reports which interactions succeeded. Filling inputs is never mentioned, so a key part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented form or input filling actions, detail on action scripting depth (selectors, sequencing), independent or hands-on corroboration.
